delay.label: Response delay
delay.hint: Time to wait before sending the reply to chat

maxLength.label: Max response length
maxLength.hint: Maximum number of characters per reply

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.hint: Higher values make output more random and creative

maxTokens.label: Max tokens
maxTokens.hint: Maximum length of the generated response

topP.label: Top P
topP.hint: Nucleus sampling — controls diversity of output

frequencyPenalty.label: Frequency penalty
frequencyPenalty.hint: Reduces repetition of the same phrases

maxMemories.label: Max memories
maxMemories.hint: How many facts the AI can remember

retentionDays.label: Retention days
retentionDays.hint: How long memories are kept before expiring

importanceThreshold.label: Importance threshold
importanceThreshold.hint: Minimum score for a fact to be stored

enable.label: Enable autonomous mode
enable.hint: AI speaks on its own when chat is quiet

idleTimeout.label: Idle timeout
idleTimeout.hint: Seconds of silence before AI can speak on its own

mood.label: Mood
mood.hint: Default emotional tone for autonomous messages
